subject: Read multiple files from a folder and provide as option for user to select

messages.author: 68b5eaaa42a157df
messages.subject: Read multiple files from a folder and provide as option for user to select
parts:
Hi,

I want to make a function in the Sidebar panel which will read all the CSV files in a folder/directory and then provide them as option(as selectInput) for the user to select. When the user selects an option(that would be the file), then the respective data of the selected option/file should get loaded and displayed.

Following are my server.R and ui.R codes:

server.R

  #   Printing the list of available files
  output$selFile <- renderUI({
    datalist <- list() 
    files <- list.files(pattern="\\.csv$")
    for(file in files) {
      stem <- gsub("\\.csv$","",file)
      datalist[[stem]] <- read.csv(file)
      
    }
    selectInput("file1", "Choose a CSV file", files)
  })
  
  #   Storing the selected file as a dataset
  dataset <- reactive({
    inFile <- input$file1
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    read.csv(file=inFile$datapath, header=TRUE, sep=",")
  })
  
  #   Read the Data File
  output$contents <- renderTable({
    dataset()
  })

ui.R

# Define UI for the Outlier Detection Application
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  # Application title
  headerPanel("Application"), 
  
  
  # Sidebar with controls to select the variable plot against mpg
  # and to specify whether outliers should be included
  sidebarPanel(
    uiOutput("selFile")
  ), 
  
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(id="tabSet", 
                tabPanel("Data", tableOutput("contents")), 
                tabPanel("YYY", verbatimTextOutput("summary"))
    )
  )
))


Any help would be great. Thanks

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Read multiple files from a folder and provide as option for user to select
parts:
Infile does not have a member dataset.
Why are you loading all the csvs?

I suggest you try to write the selection code first by making an example without csvs, then add csvs once you get comfortable with that.

-Alex

parts:

You are right. Loading all the files together may make the app slow. I think I will use file.choose instead to just open a pop up and let the user select the file from the explorer on his/her own.
